_comment: Maps ESPN's competitor `abbrev` code (a stable 2-letter US state postal code or 3-letter country code on every team object) to our fixed 20-slot region label. We match on `abbrev` rather than the `location` display string because ESPN formats `location` inconsistently - sometimes the full state/country name ('Clarendon Hills Illinois'), sometimes already abbreviated ('Las Vegas NV', 'Tokyo JPN') - with no reliable pattern, while `abbrev` is always the short code regardless. Any team whose abbrev isn't a key here is reported as UNRESOLVED by fetch-scores.ps1 rather than guessed.
_openSlots: These 4 international regions are multi-country pools. The actual qualifying country isn't known until early-to-mid August, right before the LLWS starts. Once the 2026 qualifiers conclude, add an entry here mapping that country's ESPN `abbrev` code to the region label, e.g. "VEN": "LATIN AMERICA" (fetch-scores.ps1 prints the abbrev alongside the location for any UNRESOLVED team, so you don't have to guess it). Until then, any team from these regions will show up as UNRESOLVED when the script runs.
